## Design note

The one you do not see coming: a plain dark sedan with a big V8, no light bar and no push bar. Lighter and cleaner through the air than the Cruiser, so it gets to pursuit speed sooner and keeps pulling past it; rear-drive with a mild LSD, it rewards a smooth driver and punishes a ham-fisted one. Lights come on only once it is already on your bumper.

## How this car breaks

Modern full-size UHSS unibody with heavy-duty cooling and suspension, but no push bar or reinforced bumper beam: a shove bends the bumper cover and radiator support like any big sedan. Long rear overhang crumples in rear-enders; four doors mean four weak spots in a T-bone.

## Sources (type)

- spec-class data for 2010s full-size RWD V8 sport sedans and their fleet versions
- owner dyno averages for high-output 6.2 L pushrod V8s
- engineering tables (tire radius, ride frequency, caliper hydraulics)

All values are class-typical figures for the archetype, rounded; no single real vehicle is reproduced.

## Inertia

Box approximation about the CG, scaled for mass concentration (`k < 1`: mass near the centre, e.g. mid-engine; `k → 1`: mass at the ends):

```
I_roll  = k_r · m·(W² + H²)/12
I_pitch = k_p · m·(L² + H²)/12
I_yaw   = k_y · m·(W² + L²)/12
```

| roll | 913 | 0.80 | 730 |
| pitch | 4296 | 0.92 | 3950 |

Peak **308 kW @ 5800 rpm**, **575 N·m @ 4000 rpm**. Idle 650 / redline 6000 / limiter 6300 rpm. Rotating inertia 0.23 kg·m² (class: 0.10 small four … 0.30 big-block). Engine braking 10% of peak torque = 58 N·m. Power-to-weight 162 kW/t.

## Drivetrain

5-speed automatic with torque converter, short pursuit final drive (runs into the limiter in 5th at ≈ 260 km/h), clutch-type rear LSD. Layout **RWD**; front diff: open; rear diff: clutch LSD, preload 40 N·m, power ramp 0.35, coast ramp 0.20. Torque converter: stall 2400 rpm, 1.9× at stall, couples 1:1 from 2800 rpm (class-typical for the gearbox). Clutch capacity 1.60 × peak torque = 920 N·m. Shift time 0.28 s.

| Gear | Ratio | Overall | km/h @ redline |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 3.59 | 13.28 | 59 |
| 2 | 2.19 | 8.10 | 96 |
| 3 | 1.41 | 5.22 | 150 |
| 4 | 1.00 | 3.70 | 211 |
| 5 | 0.83 | 3.07 | 254 |

Final drive 3.70, reverse 3.16. Speeds use the driven-wheel loaded radius 0.345 m.

## Suspension

Springs from ride frequency, `k = m_s·(2πf)²` with sprung corner mass `m_s = axle load/2 − unsprung`; dampers `c = 2ζ·√(k·m_s)`, ζ = 0.32 bump, rebound = 1.5 × bump.

| Axle | m_s | f | Wheel rate k | Bump c | Rebound c | Travel |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Front | 477 kg | 1.55 Hz | 45200 N/m | 2970 N·s/m | 4460 N·s/m | 0.16 m |
| Rear | 418 kg | 1.65 Hz | 44900 N/m | 2770 N·s/m | 4160 N·s/m | 0.17 m |

Anti-roll bars from a roll-gradient target of 2.9°/g with 62% of roll stiffness at the front. Roll arm h − h_rc = 0.421 m (roll centres 0.08 m F / 0.12 m R). Required total K_φ = m·g·arm/φ = 154960 N·m/rad; springs give k·t²/2 = 57912 F / 58237 R N·m/rad; bars supply the rest as `arb_n_per_m = K_bar/t²` = **14900 F / 200 R N/m** (clamped at ≥ 0). Resulting gradient 2.9°/g, front share 62%. Bump stops 180000 N/m.

Alignment: camber -1.0° F / -0.8° R, toe +0.00° F / +0.15° R (+ = in), caster 6.5°.

## Brakes

Full-pedal line pressure 100 bar.

- Front: 355 mm disc, pistons per side 44 mm + 42 mm → A = 29.1 cm², r_eff = D/2 − 25 mm = 152 mm, pad μ = 0.42: T = 2·μ·p·A·r_eff = 2·0.42·100 bar·29.1 cm²·0.152 m = **3723 N·m**
- Rear: 330 mm disc, pistons per side 45 mm → A = 15.9 cm², r_eff = D/2 − 25 mm = 140 mm, pad μ = 0.4: T = 2·μ·p·A·r_eff = 2·0.4·100 bar·15.9 cm²·0.140 m = **1781 N·m**

Lock check at 1 g on μ = 1 (load transfer m·a·h/L): front needs 2231 N·m/wheel (capacity 1.67×), rear needs 956 N·m/wheel (capacity 1.86×).

`wp_vehicle` gives the axle `bias_front` favours its full `max_torque_*` and scales the other by (1 − b)/b, so `max_torque_*` holds the caliper capacity per wheel and `bias_front` acts as the proportioning valve: the rear is trimmed to the same lock margin as the front (ideal rear = T_f · lock_r/lock_f = 1594 N·m), never boosted above its caliper capacity. Rear capacity exceeds that, so `bias_front` = T_r/(T_r + ideal) = **0.528** → delivered 3720 N·m front / 1591 N·m rear per wheel at full pedal. Handbrake 1430 N·m per rear wheel.

## Steering

Ratio 15.5:1. Kerb-to-kerb turning circle 11.8 m → outer-front path radius 5.78 m, rear-axle-centre radius 4.13 m → mean road-wheel lock δ = atan(L/R) = **0.630 rad (36.1°)** (outer 31.4°, inner 42.1° at full Ackermann; `ackermann_frac` 0.60). Rack speed 1.4 rad/s.

## Damage lattice (`data/lattices/sentinel_shade.json`)

300 nodes, 1909 beams, 8 detachables, 21 component mounts.

- Steel hood: 132 hood beams aluminum → mild_steel.
- Detachables: steel bumpers ×2.3 break impulse / ×4 mass; steel hood ×1.4 / ×1.6.
- Police package: heavy-duty components fail at × the stock intrusion (Battery ×1.3, Radiator ×1.3, SteeringRack ×1.3); front bumper fixings ×1.2 detach impulse.
